findings.summary: A7.1 declares the permissions manifest exhaustive and fail-on-extra, but the bound manifest lacks lifecycle-deletion and disposition permissions and schema-migration principal, action, and provider permissions while A8 and A10.3 mandate destructive disposition and forward-only migration execution. Required operations are therefore either denied or cannot be authorized by a complete tested oracle.
findings.requiredResolution: Add explicit narrowly scoped permission actions, eligible principals, provider scopes, protected-path, retention, deletion, and migration selectors, and denial, race, and retry tests. Update every affected hash and obtain a new exact-revision review.

escalations.reason: IRREV-G2-R2-001 is an unresolved major authorization-oracle gap: the Exam mandates irreversible lifecycle disposition and forward-only migration operations that the exhaustive bound permissions manifest does not explicitly authorize or test. A qualified human irreversible-operations specialist must evaluate the gap unless a revised exact target closes it; this agent cannot waive or accept it.

Lifecycle deletion or disposition and destructive schema migration can create irreversible external effects or material rights impacts. Any such execution requires separately verified eligible-human authorization under a complete, narrowly scoped, tested permission oracle; this review record does not authorize execution.
